newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 7.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Nov. 7:
WASHINGTON - USAir Group Inc. announces it will buy as many as 400 new jetliners worth as much as $15 billion over the next decade from the European consortium Airbus Industrie.
NEW YORK - The stock market surged, fueled by widespread investor relief that pro-business Republicans kept control of Congress despite President Clinton's re-election.
WASHINGTON - Bell Atlantic Corp. and Nynex Corp. agreed to guarantee the jobs of 70,000 members of the Communications Workers of America when they merge next year.

WASHINGTON - Washington real estate executives and business leaders said they plan to challenge the commercial tax assessment law that D.C. voters passed, saying it could force landlords out of the District by raising the cost of doing business.
